comments.note: DapperMovieCatalogRepository.GetMovieListAsync uses results.AsList() (Dapper extension) to avoid double-enumeration. This is correct, but if the result set is very large, callers may want a streaming approach in a future milestone.

The MovieListSql constant uses a raw string literal (C# 11). The GROUP BY clause groups only on m.movie_id; in strict SQL mode (ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY), this is valid only if all non-aggregated SELECT columns are functionally dependent on movie_id. This holds for the current schema (PK), but reviewers should be aware if the query is ever extended with columns from joined tables.

InMemoryMovieCatalogRepository (tests/VideoIndexer.Tests/Fixtures/) and FakeMovieCatalogRepository (tests/VideoIndexer.App.Tests/TestHelpers/) serve similar purposes but are in different locations with different class names. A future cleanup could consolidate them, though this is out of scope for M4.

comments.note: FakeMovieCatalogRepository.GetMovieListAsync throws _exception synchronously (not via Task.FromException). This means the exception fires before a Task is returned rather than as a faulted Task. For the LoadAsync_SetsIsLoadingFalse_InFinallyBlock unit test this is fine — the synchronous throw propagates through the awaiter into the try/finally. No functional defect, but differs from production async behavior where a network-level failure would arrive as a faulted Task.

comments.note: No security findings — all OWASP Top 10 categories reviewed; no Critical or High issues identified. All parameterized queries use Dapper @Parameter syntax correctly; MovieListSql is a compile-time const with zero runtime interpolation; no hardcoded secrets; no injection surfaces; no auth/access-control gaps (single-user WinExe context).

A03 (Injection) — Future-milestone advisory: MovieListQuery (src/VideoIndexer.Core/Models/MovieListQuery.cs) is currently an empty record by M4 design. When M5 adds filter/search predicates, all new fields MUST be incorporated into the SQL exclusively via Dapper parameterized variables (@Param syntax). Any inline string concatenation or interpolation into MovieListSql would introduce a SQL injection vector. No action required for M4.

A09 (Logging) — Info: GetMovieListAsync in DapperMovieCatalogRepository.cs (line ~148) carries no exception logging per the repository's stated architectural policy (callers are responsible). Acceptable for M4. Future consideration: if the caller (library scanner or VM) does not surface database errors to the UI or log them, failures could be silently swallowed. No blocking issue.

comments.note: FakeMovieCatalogRepository.GetMovieListAsync (tests/VideoIndexer.App.Tests/TestHelpers/FakeMovieCatalogRepository.cs): changed `throw _exception` to `return Task.FromException<IReadOnlyList<MovieListItem>>(_exception)`.
